Ⓑ
 2 padaM, AspadaM, sTAnaM, BAjanaM; ‘riches are the a(bode) of calamities’ saMpadaH padaM (AspadaM) ApadAM.

Abortion,Ⓒs.ⒹgarBasrAvaH-pAtaH; ‘to cause a(bortion)’ BrURahatyAM kf 8 U; ‘causing a(bortion)’ BrURahatyA.

Ⓑ
 2 akAlakfta, nizPala, moGa, vyarTa (as an attempt).

Abound,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓ(with, in) sakF-pF pass., or by bahu, BUyizWa, in comp.; BUyizWavfkzaM vanaM; bahukOtukaH sa deSaH ‘a(bound)s in curiosities’.
Ⓝ[Abound]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹAQya, saMkIrRa, Akula, prAya, in comp.
ⓃAbundant,Ⓒa.Ⓓbahula, praBUta, pracura, vipula, BUri.
Ⓝ[Abundant]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹbahuSaH, anekavAraM, vipulaM.
ⓃAbundance,ⒶbAhulyaM, prAcuryaM.

About,Ⓒprep.Ⓓpari; pari-i ‘go a(bout)’ &c.
Ⓑ
 2 deSIya (with numerals); ‘a(bout) five years old’ paMcavarzadeSIyaH.
Ⓑ
 3 (Regarding) ADikftya, prati, uddiSya; saMbadDa-anuvidDa-gata-vizaye in comp.; ‘I ask a(bout) my friend’ mitragataM pfcCAmi; parAjayAnuvidDA AlApAH &c.
Ⓑ
 4 kfte, arTe, arTaM, hetoH.
Ⓑ
 5 paritaH, aBitaH, (acc.); samIpaM, samIpe, pArSvataH, nikawe, (loc.).
Ⓑ
 6 (Nearly) with numerals upa, Asanna, adUra, in comp.; upacaturAH ‘a(bout) four’.
Ⓔadv.Ⓓ(Showing prospective fut.) ex. by fut. part., unmuKa (KI f.), udyata, Asanna, or desid.; anuyAsyan munitanayAM (

) ‘a(bout) to follow’ &c.; jiGAMsyamAno naraH ‘a(bout) to be killed’; AsannamaraRaH ‘a(bout) to die’; AsannarAjyanASaH ‘a(bout) to lose the realm’.
Ⓑ
 2 prAya-kalpa, in comp.; ‘it is a(bout) noon’ maDyAhna-prAyaH-kalpaH-samayaH; ‘what are you a(bout)’ kiM kartumudyatosi, kiMkAryavyagrosi, kimAraMBastvaM.
Ⓑ
 3 paritaH, aBitaH.
Ⓑ
 4 itastataH, sTAnAtsTAnaM.

Above,Ⓒadv.ⒹaDi or aBi pr.; upari, uparizwAt, UrDvaM; ‘just a(bove)’ uparyupari (acc.)
Ⓔa.ⒹprAgukta, pUrvanirdizwa.
Ⓔprep.Ⓓupari (gen.); ati pr.; aDika, uttara, viSizwa, (abl.); ‘a(bove) calculation’ atisaMKya; ‘he stands a(bove) all’ sa sarvezAM mUrDni tizWati; ‘a(bove) mentioned’ pUrvokta, prAgukta; ‘to be a(bove)’ UrDvaM sTA 1 P, aBiBU 1 P; See Excel.
